openTickets.summary: [payments] Provider errors are dropped: checkout gets payment_info { retried: 0 } when the provider call fails (e.g. 429 throttle)
openTickets.descriptionSummary:
When shop-api cannot get an answer from the payment provider, the error never reaches checkout. Checkout receives payment_info { retried: 0 }, which looks the same as "the provider had nothing to report", and failure_reasons has no payment: entry.

Evidence: the same order paid twice on integration on 7 Oct. The first call was throttled by the provider (429, 500 requests per minute) and the error was dropped; the second was declined by the provider.

Root cause: the payment client puts the error inside the details JSON instead of the top-level error_code and error_details, so the webhook handler records nothing.

Fix: lift error_code and error_details from details in PaymentClient, add the same fallback in the webhook handler, and add unit tests with the 429 payload.
openTickets.elfoqsyNote: Same root cause as CORE-18891. This one makes the 429 visible; that one raises the limit.

openTickets.summary: Raise the rate limit for the Acme Shop payment API keys in all environments (429 at 500/min)
openTickets.descriptionSummary:
shop-api calls the payment provider with its own API key, which falls back to the account default of 500 requests per minute. The same key is used by every Acme Shop environment, so non-prod traffic and test automation share the limit with prod.

Volume on 7 to 8 Oct: integration peaks at 15 payment calls per minute, staging at 23. Prod checkouts peak at 614 per minute, so prod would be throttled as soon as the new checkout is enabled there.

Request: set the rate limit on the key to 2000 per minute in every environment and region; make sure no account-wide limit overrides it; check the refunds quota; and issue separate keys for non-prod environments.
openTickets.elfoqsyNote: Sits on the Platform board. Your 3546 only surfaces the error; this one raises the limit.

openTickets.summary: Order export never completes when the image resizer stalls
openTickets.descriptionSummary:
Completed steps have already been written to the cache, so the Redis timeout is never triggered and the order export waits for product thumbnails that never come when the image resizer stalls.

To reproduce: delete export-step-timeout, then start an export with export_id exp_resizer_timeout.

openTickets.summary: Bundle discount applied to the whole cart when cart.split_bundles = false
openTickets.descriptionSummary:
When a cart is priced with split_bundles: false, the bundle lines are correctly kept together, but the bundle discount is applied to every line of the cart instead of the bundle's own items.

Actual: a 10% bundle discount reduces the whole cart total.
Expected: the 10% bundle discount reduces only the bundle's items.
